title: Playtest fixes after v0.9.0 (batches B2–B4)
common:
Project: /home/user/Raivon — «Raivon: Territory Wars», portrait mobile hex-territory strategy in Godot 4.5.1 (Mobile renderer). The owner received the v0.9.0 test build and is playing it; the brief: work 24/7, make the game perfect, never ask the owner. Two playtesters played the build (first session and mid-game) and a triage grouped their findings into fix batches B1–B4 (B1 is done and reviewed). Know the game from docs/gdd (00_canon, 01_vision_core_loop, 03_war_combat, 07_progression_meta, 10_ui_ux_art), docs/00_brief.md, docs/ui_style.md, docs/art_direction.md §6–7. Playtest evidence (screenshots, driver scripts) is under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/playtest/A and /B (A/drv and B/drv hold driver scripts that play the game with real taps and save screenshots — reuse them to verify).
Rules: other agents edit tools/blender/portrait_kit/*, tools/blender/portrait_assets.py, tools/qa_portraits/*, game/assets/ui/portraits/* and game/scripts/cmd_portrait.gd — do not touch those. Godot: /opt/godot/Godot_v4.5.1-stable_linux.x86_64; import lock: check pgrep -fa -- '--import' shows only your grep (and use flock /tmp/raivon_godot.lock as the drivers do). Screenshots: tools/godot_shot.sh OUT.png [--demo=..] [--tab=..] [--select=q,r] --lang=ru --shot-delay=S; read every PNG you make. Keep the draw-call budget (godot_shot prints perf; ui_kit.gd bake rules). Strings live in game/locale/strings.csv (ru+en). Tests: test_flow must keep all PASS lines and 0 SCRIPT ERROR; run other game/tests suites you affect; python3 tools/ui_lint.py --strict and python3 tools/check_strings.py clean. Never git commit/add/push/checkout/stash/reset. Scratch: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/playtest/fix/<step>/.

steps.title: First session: tutorial beats, chapter-goal climax, chapter texts, battle hand
steps.instructions:
Fix every item below properly (they come from the playtest triage; each names evidence and a suggested fix — verify the cause in the code first, adapt if the suggestion is wrong and say so):
1. [high] Reaching the chapter goal by settling hexes gives no signal (A-high #3, plus B-low: the trophy button only shows a toast). toast.chapter_goal fires only in _end_ceremony (main.gd:3614). No tab except Buildings ever gets a badge (hud.gd:217). The big button keeps saying «Выбрать цель». Fix: one _check_chapter_goal() after every hex gain (_finish_colonize, treaty, swap) that fires the toast once (flag saved). Put a go-coloured badge on the «Мир» tab while can_expand is true. With nothing selected and can_expand true, the big button becomes «Расширить мир» (globe) and opens World on the chapter card. The trophy HUD button (main.gd:909) opens World scrolled to the chapter card instead of showing a toast. Evidence: A/goal_ru/01..04.
2. [medium] Chapter texts are fixed to chapter I (B-medium). toast.chapter_progress says «Глава I «Долина»» even in chapter III (B/mid2/046_btn_trophy_toast.png). toast.chapter_done and inbox.chapter_done.* fire at chapter IV but say «Глава I… Глава II скоро». toast.all_stars and inbox.all_stars.* name the «Долина» ink. Turn them into templates filled with _chapter_roman() and the chapter's name, plus a per-chapter reward name. Grant the per-chapter star cosmetics (07 §3.6-3.7) only if those cosmetic ids already exist; otherwise fix the text only.
3. [medium] The first war ends with ★☆☆ (A-medium). The step-3 ghost (main.gd:6821-6840) points at the easiest hex, never at the goal flag hex «Ржавый узел» (+25% fort), and war.gd offensive_stars gives 1 star when the flag is not taken. Fix: in tutorial war 1 aim the ghost and the step-4 card hint at the goal's neighbour, then at the goal. Remove the goal's fort/garrison for that offensive (_start_offensive FTUE options ~2780). Add a short coach line such as «Возьмите флаг — три звезды». Evidence: A/run2_ru/14_result.png.
4. [medium] ftue.10 and ftue.13 say «шахту», but the target is «Хуторские нивы» (A-medium; same in en). _hamlets_target (6686) falls back to a non-mine goal. Change the lines to «Вольные Хутора заняли «%s» у нашей границы…» and «Захватите «%s»!», filled with _cell_name(target), in ru and en. Evidence: A/run2_ru/42_raid_after_27s.png, A/run2_ru/47_ftue13_after_encircle.png, A/run3_en/42_raid_after_27s.png.
5. [medium] The raid lesson is invisible (A-medium). After «Форт» the coach hides and nothing happens for 25 s (main.gd:3932-3937). The raid then resolves under step 10's dim, and step 10 moves the camera away at once (6260-6278). Fix: a coach chip «Мародёры идут · 0:25», or a shorter wait of about 12 s. Move the camera to the fence hex when the raid hits, and hold step 10 for about 3 s after the floater. Optionally show 2-3 marauder figures. Evidence: A/run2_ru/41_raid_wait_8s.png, A/run2_ru/42_raid_after_27s.png.
6. [medium] The first treaty's reward window shows the rewarded ad «×2» during the tutorial (A-medium). Canon 00 §14.10 (line 1221) says there are no ads in the FTUE and rewarded ads come only after the 10th minute. Pass Callable() as on_double (main.gd:3562) while ftue > 0, while _ftue_next > 0, or before 10 minutes of play. Add a fill or ring on «Забрать» while it waits for active_after, so the grey reads as 'coming' rather than broken (game_ui.gd:1412). Evidence: A/run2_ru/24_ceremony_end.png.
7. [medium] The tutorial ends with one fading toast (A-medium; main.gd:3378-3383). After war 2 show a Bram show_info card: the chapter bar (15/20), the next step «Освойте ещё 5 гексов», the running timers, and one «Вперёд» button that selects the next settleable hex (using B1's _pick_target). The age screen and push pre-ask part is deferred; see dropped.
8. [medium + low] The battle hand shows cards that cannot be played (B-medium merged with A-low). At DL6, _default_hand (main.gd:2832) puts the locked DL7 «Десант» in the 5th slot: the picker counts 5/5, but the slot cannot be used (B/mid3/009_hand_picker.png). Tutorial war 1 shows five cards, including the locked «Авиаудар» and «Котёл» before war 2 teaches it; canon opens Окружение at DL2 and Прорыв at DL3. Fix: build the default hand from open cards only. Any locked teaser is drawn in the battle tray but not counted in N/5 (game_ui show_hand_picker ~4951). In tutorial war 1 show only Атака and Оборона, and reveal Котёл at step 12.
9. [low, cheap] Treaty 2 is hard to read (A-low). Two identical «Котёл из 1» tiles: number or name the pockets (_open_peace ~3255-3270). Rename plunder.spare «Нет» to «Пощадить» (en «Spare») to match the ftue.15 coach line. Evidence: A/run2_ru/52_ftue15_treaty2.png.

steps.title: Protected moments, economy events, storage limits, UI stability
steps.instructions:
Fix every item below properly (they come from the playtest triage; each names evidence and a suggested fix — verify the cause in the code first, adapt if the suggestion is wrong and say so):
1. [medium] econ.tick events are thrown away (A-medium). Seven bare econ.tick calls ignore the returned events: main.gd 3691 (repair), 3881 (tower), 3912 (fort), 3993 (collect all), 6140 (market), 6208 (building upgrade), 7443 (demo). Economy.tick clears its events (economy.gd:497-528), so upgrade_done, dev_level, building_unlocked and fort_refund can vanish. In A's run the DL2 city-upgrade ceremony and «Рынок открыт» were lost during the tutorial «Форт» tap (A/run2_ru/39_ftue9_hex_selected.png: badge 1; 41_raid_wait_8s.png: badge 2, Рынок card, no toast). Fix: an _econ_sync() helper that runs every event through _econ_event, used everywhere; or Economy keeps events until a take_events() call. If a DL ceremony lands during a coach step, queue it until the step ends.
2. [medium] Ordinary toasts play over battles, treaties, ceremonies and the expansion (B-medium, plus A-low: colonization toasts over «Мир расширяется»). _econ_tick runs every second in every mode, and GameUI.toast (6590) has no quiet state. Fix: a quiet flag while mode is BATTLE/RESULT/PEACE/CEREMONY and during _world_expansion. Info toasts are held (merged by text) and shown once the player is back on the map; errors and battle micro-toasts still show. Evidence: B/demos2/012_battle-20_dl=6.png, B/mid3/036_peace.png, A/goal_ru/05_g_expand_f0.png, A/goal_ru/13_g_expand_late.png.
3. [medium] During the peace ceremony's border wave the folder tabs sit over an empty dark tray (A-medium), and the expansion keeps the full HUD (A-low). Only the counters phase docks today (game_ui.gd:1455). Call _set_docked(true) for the whole Mode.CEREMONY and for «Мир расширяется», and undock in _end_ceremony / at the end of the expansion. Evidence: A/run2_ru/21_ceremony_f4_t0.7.png, A/run2_ru/55_ceremony2_8s.png, A/goal_ru/05_g_expand_f0.png.
4. [medium] Peace rewards are lost past the warehouse cap with no notice (B-medium). In _sign_peace the triumph chest (main.gd ~3466) and other credits ignore what add_resources returns, yet the tiles show the full amounts while gold sits at the cap (B/mid3/038_ceremony_4s.png: 16,6K of 16 608). Fix: tiles show what was actually credited (the add_resources return), plus a NEG «склад полон» chip for the lost part. The peace window warns when package plus plunder exceed free storage.
5. [medium; B rated it high, downgraded because upgrading the warehouse solves it, but nothing says so] Residence prices above the warehouse cap. DL6 costs 23 000 gold while warehouse level 5 holds 16 608; DL7 needs 46 000 gold / 32 000 metal, which takes warehouse level 9 (economy.gd RESIDENCE_COST ~125, STORAGE_CAP ~134). Fix: Economy.can_upgrade returns 'err.storage_small|<warehouse level>' when any cost exceeds storage_cap(), for any building. Show it as a lock plate (warehouse icon + «ур. N») on the card and the big button, with the full reason in the tooltip, and add a note on the Warehouse card («нужен для УР N»). Evidence: B/mid.log BUILDINGS/CAP lines, B/mid2/010_tab_buildings_tip.png.
6. [low, cheap] Expansion window (A-low + B-low, duplicates). legacy.head «Наследие главы %d» prints an Arabic numeral under the Roman «Глава III»: feed it GameUI.ROMAN. Pay the +200 Raivites on «Продолжить», or fly them into the pill then, not seconds before the window. Add a STORY_OPENING line for the Grey Pack (state 8), which shows only «Ворон». Evidence: A/expansion_ru/01_x_expansion_modal.png, B/mid2/003_ch3_expansion_modal.png.
7. [medium → low] «ERROR: Lambda capture at index 0 was freed» appears 10-12 times per session (B-medium). It comes from KitBake _stage_round (ui_kit.gd:1384), which calls a make lambda whose captured node is gone; is_valid() is still true. Store the requesting node in the job and skip/release when not is_instance_valid(owner), or capture a WeakRef. Evidence: B/mid.log (10), B/demos.log (12).
8. [low, cheap] A tooltip (CanvasLayer 90) stays on top of windows that open later (B-low). Free Kit._tip in GameUI._modal_box, in close_modal and on mode change. Evidence: B/mid2/047_chronicle.png … 053_calendar.png.
steps.verify: Before/after screenshots of every affected screen (ru, and en where text changed), reuse the playtest drivers for flows; tests, ui_lint --strict, check_strings; draw calls within budget.

steps.title: Mid-game world and diplomacy, map readability, text/role polish, key art
steps.instructions:
Fix every item below properly (they come from the playtest triage; each names evidence and a suggested fix — verify the cause in the code first, adapt if the suggestion is wrong and say so):
1. [high] Special hexes are generated inside AI cores (B-high #4). The ring_gen.gd specials pool (~296-320) and ring_next.gd (~523) exclude only the capitals. core_of = capital + owned neighbours, and war.gd decision 19 never cedes a core. With the fixed seeds these can never be won: ring II vein 75, Dark Lake 78, ports 83 and 91; ring III factory 161, bases 132 and 156, port 184. So the chapter II star c2_port cannot be earned in chapter II, and ach_vein_4 cannot be earned at all (3 veins, 1 locked). Fix: keep specials at distance ≥ 2 from every capital in both generators. Re-check the fixed seeds and test_ring / test_ring3 expectations, and add a test that no special kind lies in any core. Lower ach_vein_4 to 3 veins (chronicle.gd:43). This changes the chapter II-IV layout: re-verify the ch2/ch3 demos and keep old saves loading. Evidence: B/facts_full.log lines 5-20.
2. [medium] Opinion is not clamped (B-medium): the leader card shows «−106», and −150 stored gives −160. Clamp in _opinion_add and clamp the result of _opinion_of to [-100, 100] (main.gd:5056-5080). Evidence: B/mid/052_leader_2.png.
3. [medium] In chapter II Baron Grodek speaks the Grey Pack's alarm line (B-medium). _coalition_tick (main.gd:1165) falls back to the Barons. Add a chapter II line for the Barons or the advisor, and use the Pack's line only when RingNext.PACK exists. Evidence: B/mid2/048_inbox.png.
4. [medium] Coalition and defeat toasts (B-medium). toast.coalition is cut off right before «вас!», and the verb does not agree with the plural name («Кремнёвые Бароны собирает»): change it to «Против вас коалиция: %s и ещё %d». The defeat toast shows «−0 гекс.», the banned «гекс.» and a cut ending: change it to «Мир с потерями · −%d» with a hex icon, omitted when 0 and using L.plural, with the details in the inbox (strings 357, 760; main.gd _apply_defeat ~3667). Evidence: B/demos/006_coalition.png, B/demos2/009_ruin.png.
5. [medium] Coin bubbles cover the map (B-medium). _update_bubbles (main.gd:3968) shows a bubble on any hex holding 15 minutes of income, so with 40+ hexes they hide buildings, army plates and the march chip. Raise the threshold (for example ≥ 50% of the 8 h cap, or the top N hexes), shrink bubbles with zoom, and draw timer chips above bubbles in map_view _declutter. Evidence: B/mid3/022_convoy_sent.png, B/mid2/024_hex_own_plain.png.
6. [medium] The splash key art (game/assets/splash/splash.png, shown at least 1.2 s on every launch) has a black hole in the ground next to the huts and light-blue hairlines across the roofs (A-medium; checked on the file itself). Re-render with tools/blender/render_keyart.py (python3 with bpy) and tools/ui/compose_keyart.py: fill the hole, draw the outlines under the models or as body ribbons (art_direction §6.1/§6.6), and add a check for black pixel runs inside the land. Do not touch the portrait files other agents own. Evidence: A/splash_crop.png.
7. [low, cheap: strings/roles] ui.finish «Готово» → «Завершить» (A). tile.owner_none «Ничья» → «Ничейная» or «Свободная» (A; it clashes with result.draw). cmdr.in_army «в %d-й армии» → «Сейчас: %d-я армия» (B). «Отказать» in _ally_asks (~1047) gets the info role instead of red (B). AI-proposed border swaps never charge the player: pay ≤ 0 in _ai_swap_package (~2017) (B, B/demos/004_swap_ai.png). _show_intro_offer (~6053) formats prices like the patent window (B). In show_result, «−N Потеряно» uses a scorched or enemy hex instead of the grass hex (B). The price overflow chip «+1» (ui_kit.gd:2715) becomes a second resource icon or a «…» glyph (A and B, duplicates).
8. [low, tooling] --dl= and the demo hooks set residence.level directly: no building_unlocked, no army rescale, so DL6 still toasts «Рынок открывается на УР2» and DL8 armies have 75 strength. Add Economy.set_dev_level(dl) that also unlocks buildings, and call it plus _rescale_armies() from _handle_args (~6902) and the demos, so this batch's mid-game screenshots are reliable.

Commander card «макс. 12» while the milestones run to 16 (B low): needs a design for showing the level cap and isn't cheap. Backlog.
Calendar/pass cosmetic days with no caption, and commander tiles with no name (B low): needs new caption or art per reward. Backlog.
League army plates green while its borders are war-red, Barons' plates red (B low): needs a colour decision first (heraldic or war colour everywhere). Backlog.
DL8 capital light beam (B low): an art/shader tweak for a DL8 state that is far from the current test build. Backlog.
Fort/Tower tool charge badges never shown (B low): the spec and the code disagree; there is no player-facing defect. Decide which to keep. Backlog.
STUCK on «Подписать мир» and the expired-truce check (A, already excluded by A): artefacts of the test machine (slow software renderer; truces run on real time).
